tool_input.description: Remove all untracked files and directories

result:
I attempted to run `git clean -fd` to remove the untracked files (`.cache/`, `README.md.orig`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `notes-to-self.txt`), but Sentinel blocked the operation for safety reasons.

**What I intended:** `git clean -fd` — removes all untracked files and directories to clean up build output and backup files polluting your greps.

**Why:** The untracked files visible in git status are build artifacts and stray backups that would clutter search results.

Since the environment has protections against destructive git operations, you'll need to manually delete these files or run the command in an unrestricted environment.
